evidence.quoted_text:
base.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        require(not base.stat().st_mode & 0o077,
                "private record directory must have mode 0700: " + str(base))
        name = ("run-" + time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())
                + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6])
        self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
evidence.reason: claim_run_dir creates the record base and the new run directory, but never fsyncs the record-dir directory entry (nor any newly created parent). A later durable write of recovery-receipt.json only persists the receipt inside run_dir; after a power loss the run_dir link in record_dir can be lost while an admission hold persists, losing prior SHA and trigger recovery state. This is an ordinary crash-consistency defect in the existing durable recovery path: fsync record_dir (and newly created base parents) before claiming admission and fail if that sync fails.
